question: According to the Ministry of Textile 2022-23, which state is the second largest producer of cotton?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Maharashtra**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Maharashtra** is the **second largest producer of cotton** in India according to the **Ministry of Textile's 2022-23 report**.
 
• The state has a significant contribution to the country's cotton production, following Gujarat, which is the largest producer.
 
• Maharash
